scope: Frontend workbench refinement. Existing Precision Finance tokens/branding/themes and all backend financial contracts preserved; no commit or push.

environment.frontend: optimized Next.js 127.0.0.1:3000 in labelled Terminal session

separate_offline_suite.method: Temporary Next on 3002 targets an unused loopback port. Real proxy 503 in Light and Dark; main FastAPI remained running. Temporary server stopped.

workbench_tests: Real UI origination to actual saved account, explicit manager disbursement, partial repayment at 1440x900, 1024x900 and 390x844
Receipt/journal selection and linked inspection do not change URL
Ordinary balanced-journal footer actually in viewport at 1440x900; document does not scroll
Exact frozen retry, 409 collision, actual auditor 403, one receipt and principal 9100 / interest 0 / penalty 0 paise
Draft amount survives closing/reopening repayment and switching records
Unsent origination name/phone/terms persist across client navigation and safe step changes
Command palette keyboard Enter/Escape, role visibility, Alt account shortcuts
Known-loan header selector opens account directly from discovery, persists after refresh
Native tab query changes are reflected on reload/deep links
Lost actual committed HTTP response: original actor/body/key restored on refresh, exact retry gives same receipt; changed-key/payload tests disabled before verification
Actual 48-row saved schedule scrolls in named record region with document scrollY=0
All existing financial, themes, cold load, clipboard, viewport, source deduplication, atomic overpayment and guided demo checks retained

numerical_case.exact_retry: same original receipt/journal IDs and no new receipt

measurement.method: Actual Chrome pointer clicks; fill/selectOption excluded and field entries separate. Query changes count as URL changes. One automated production sample each; timings are not human task times or controlled performance results. Background load/database size/cache differed.
measurement.timing_claim: No uniform speedup claimed; some timings and retry total elapsed increased.

resolved_review_findings: A created account initially stayed under /new-loan and disappeared on refresh; confirmed creation now automatically opens its canonical loan URL
Stored tab state initially overrode explicit History links; native History API now preserves tab deep links and refresh without RSC navigation
Rapid reopen initially missed autofocus while Radix exit presence retained content; explicit open focus and immediate aria-hidden for closed content fixed it
Posting result initially hid the journal footer; journal is now placed before duplicate snapshot balance detail and is asserted in viewport
Modified-payload/source-alias testing now requires a verified original receipt/journal, preserving recovery safety when an outcome is unknown
Screenshot helper blurred command input before Enter; captures now preserve keyboard focus
Initial dual-theme dev checks refreshed older design gallery images; historical report annotated and all further captures redirected into workbench evidence
Laptop idle inspector now collapses until a record/action is selected so the full schedule is readable; active inspector remains adjacent.
limitations: No full server portfolio/search; only 12 current-tab references
Per-loan audit matching caps at 5000 global events
Unsent origination draft is not restored across full browser refresh before creation; uncertain origination still needs inspection
Explicit New repayment starts the next instruction; unknown deliveries stay frozen unless deliberately edited as new
Wide/long data scrolls internally; laptop inspector compact and not resizable
Current receivables are not historical-at-posting balances or future payoff quotes; reads are not atomic snapshots
Physical devices, Safari/Firefox and full accessibility certification untested
Demo impersonation is not production security
